# Demo Selenium JavaScript for Google Maps

> A beginner-friendly walkthrough of Selenium WebDriver browser automation in
> JavaScript, written against the well-known, publicly documented markup and
> URL encoding of Google Maps, and running three real assertion-based
> checks. Because Google's Terms of Service restrict automated querying,
> this code must never be run automatically against the live site.

## Docs

- [README](./README.md): Install, run, caution, and troubleshooting
  instructions.
- [Spec](./spec/index.md): Single source of truth for the exact three test
  scenarios, selectors, and expected strings.
- [Citation](./CITATION.cff): How to cite this software.

## Source

- [demo.js](./src/demo.js): The Selenium WebDriver demo script itself.

## Optional

- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): Instructions for AI coding agents working in
  this repo, including the non-negotiable against automated live runs.
